latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Lyrics Video Maker Free.

- Instantly create synced lyrics music videos by uploading audio files (MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, up to 200MB) and providing details.
- Simple workflow: upload audio, describe your request, and receive a 1080p MP4 download in 1–2 minutes.
- No editing software needed — AI handles lyric syncing, display, and video export.
- Anonymous users automatically receive free credits (100/7 days).
- Built-in commands for checking credits/balance, status, uploads, and exporting videos.
- Optimized for musicians and songwriters seeking fast, automatic lyrics video creation.
